terbaru.judul: DroneShield-AI: A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Framework for Real-Time Autonomous Drone Threat Detection, Behavioral Intent Classification, and Swarm Intelligence in Contested Airspace
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents DroneShield-AI, a unified open framework integrating six processing layers: RF signal classification, acoustic motor-signature detection, YOLOv8-based visual detection, evidence-weighted sensor fusion, a Behavioral Intent Classification Engine (BICE), and a Graph Neural Network Swarm Intelligence Module (GNN-SIM).

terbaru.judul: Multi-agent rendezvous in fluid flows via reinforcement learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we adopt a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approach to develop physics-informed rendezvous strategies in vortical flows.

terbaru.judul: Hybrid Metaheuristic Combining the Dragonfly Algorithm and Tabu Search for the Traveling Salesman Problem
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a hybrid metaheuristic for the TSP by combining the Dragonfly Algorithm (DA), a swarm-intelligence-based global search method, with Tabu Search (TS), a memory-based local search technique.

terbaru.judul: SGTO-MAS: Secure Gorilla Troops Optimization for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper formulates multi-agent LLM coordination as a constrained optimization problem and proposes a security-aware method for adaptive agent selection.

terbaru.judul: The Whale That Outswam Evolution: Swarm Intelligence Maximises Memory in Connectome Reservoirs
terbaru.pelajaran: Reservoir computing exploits the fixed dynamics of a recurrent network for temporal processing, requiring only a trained linear readout.
